name: basil-chicken
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: square food photograph for a minimal luxury Thai restaurant menu, part of a cohesive six-image set.
Scene/backdrop: warm ivory limestone tabletop, uncluttered, softly mottled natural stone. No backdrop horizon.

Constraints: no people, no hands, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark, no extra objects or cutlery, no decorative plants, no napkins, no collage, no frames. Food must look real, not CGI. No dramatic saturated colors.
